script:
$configDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode"
$config = Get-Content "$configDir\opencode.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
$config.plugin = @("opencode-vibeguard", "@tarquinen/opencode-dcp", "@zenobius/opencode-skillful")
$config | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Out-File -FilePath "$configDir\opencode.json" -Encoding utf8
"Fixed. Plugins now: " + ($config.plugin -join ", ")
